gap_details.2011-2012: Before the program: residency started July 2012 (program page: 'started in 2012. One resident will begin this program annually'). Not a gap.
gap_details.2012-2013..2015-2016: No resident list existed on any host: the msgme program page (Wayback 2012-10..2016-12, 17 versions) and its admissions/curriculum/department-and-faculty/program-contacts subpages list no residents; the msgme 'Meet Our Trainees' index had no Neurologic Surgery entry until Sep 2016. Common Crawl 2012-2015 (msgme prefixes) found only the same subpages. Reconstructed Yoon (2012), Grewal (2013), Clifton (2014), Gassie (2015) from their PGY on the 2016-17 roster plus alumni-page graduation years. Anyone who entered 2012-2015 and left before Sep 2016 is invisible.
gap_details.2018-2019: mayo.edu/mayo-clinic-school-of-graduate-medical-education path 301'd in Jul 2018; college.mayo.edu resident-profiles/ first captured Oct 2019 (Wayback) and not in CC before CC-MAIN-2019-43. Reconstructed Grewal, Clifton, Gassie, Akinduro, Ebot (bracketed / alumni). PHASE 2: the 2018 class was empty (Stein entered 2019); see years.2018-2019.
gap_details.2019-2020: Only a testimonial page ('See what a few residents have to say'): Stein, Ebot, Gassie (Wayback 2019-10-21; identical in CC-MAIN-2020-24, 2020-06-05). Loaded as source_type other; Grewal, Clifton, Akinduro, Ravindran reconstructed. Stein's PGY (2) is inferred: 2018 is the only unfilled class slot and she described her 'fifth and sixth year' in the future tense. PHASE 2: Stein corrected to PGY-1 (2019 entrant).
gap_details.2020-2021: No resident-profiles capture Jun 2020 - Sep 2021 (Wayback or CC). Reconstructed Clifton, Gassie, Akinduro, Ravindran. James Lee (2020 entrant) not reconstructed (first seen 2021-22, nothing before). PHASE 2: Lee added as reconstructed PGY-1.
gap_details.2021-2022: Wayback/CC 2021-09-21 testimonial list only (Akinduro, Gassie, Goyal, Lee, Montaser, Ravindran; no PGYs); loaded as other with PGYs from other years. Ebot and Stein absent but the list is partial. Jul-2022 capture is the same list minus Gassie (not loaded; July, ambiguous year).
gap_details.2022-2023: Wayback 2023-06-26 full roster with PGY headings; content-dated 2022-23 (Akinduro PGY-7 graduated 2023; De Biase PGY-1). Only one capture between Jul 2022 and Nov 2025.
gap_details.2023-2024,2024-2025: No capture of resident-profiles/ between 2023-06-26 and 2025-11-16 in Wayback; Common Crawl 2023-2025 had only the main program page and graduate-outcomes (CC-MAIN-2023-23 index failed repeatedly). Reconstructed Ravindran, Lee, Montaser, De Biase (bracketed). Perez Vega (2023) and Bendfeldt (2024) first appear in 2025-26 at PGY-3/2 after the gap: not classed as joiners, not reconstructed. Goyal's exit (between 2022-23 and 2025-26) falls in this gap. PHASE 2: Goyal, Perez Vega (2023-24, 2024-25) and Bendfeldt (2024-25) added as reconstructed from publication affiliations and NPI enumeration.
gap_details.2026-2027: Live page 2026-09-27 updated (PGYs advanced; two PGY-1s Garner, Mohamed; Ravindran added to alumni as 2026 graduate). Loaded.

departures.name: James Ebot
departures.note: Entered 2017. Last Mayo-Jax neurosurgery affiliation on papers published Sep-Nov 2020 (PMIDs 32897467, 32742839); absent from the Sep-2021 page (which lists every other expected resident), the 2022-23 roster and the alumni page. 2023 affiliation Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health (PMID 38021971). No NPI. Destination unknown. training_history th_id 2511 (end_year 2021, departure_type unknown).

departures.name: Rachel Stein
departures.note: Entered 2019 (NPI 2019-04; VCOM student affiliation to Aug 2018; Mayo-Jax affiliation from Jul 2019). TRANSFERRED to Tennessee/Semmes-Murphey (program 105) as PGY-2 for 2020-21 (Semmes bio 2020-09-29); left Tennessee by Apr 2021; UF-Jacksonville radiology affiliation 2021-26. training_history th_id 2510.

departures.name: Ansh Goyal
departures.note: Anshit Goyal, entered 2021. Mayo-Jax neurosurgery affiliation to Nov 2024; off the 2025-26 and 2026-27 rosters (classmate Montaser is PGY-6) and not on alumni page. Bio mentions an enfolded clinician-investigator program; a 2026 paper lists him under Anesthesiology and Perioperative Medicine (Mayo-Jax co-authors) but he is not on the Mayo Florida anesthesiology resident page; NPI (FL, neurosurgery) updated 2025-12. Research leave vs departure unresolved. training_history th_id 2512 (completed unknown).

problems: Only 5 roster-bearing captures in 2012-2026; 2012-16, 2018-21 and 2023-25 unobserved or partial (testimonial pages). DB programs.website is live and current. Alumni page lists Grewal as 2019 in Sep-2021 capture but 2020 from 2022 on (2020 used; fits PGY-4 in 2016-17). Yoon graduated 2018 after 6 years (program was advertised as six-year until 2015, seven-year from Nov 2015). Common Crawl index fetches that failed: CC-MAIN-2023-23 (college.mayo.edu prefix; retried, still failing - relevant to 2023-24 gap), CC-MAIN-2014-41 and CC-MAIN-2017-17 (msgme/about/resident-profiles prefix), CC-MAIN-2019-43 (mayo-clinic-school-of-graduate-medical-education prefix; path already 301). Complement is 1 but 2021 and 2026 each had 2 PGY-1s. | PHASE 2: Common Crawl data host returned 403 on 2026-09-28; CC-MAIN-2023-23 still unread (low value now that 2023-24 is covered by publication/NPI evidence).

2012-2013.reason: No resident page existed. Complement 1; the single 2012 slot is held by Yoon, who finished on schedule. PubMed Mayo-Jax neurosurgery affiliations 2012-16 (129 papers) show no other resident.

2013-2014.reason: As 2012-13: each class slot 2012-13 occupied by a resident who completed on schedule; no unknown resident in PubMed.

2015-2016.reason: As above (Gassie 2015 slot, graduated 2022). An extra non-complement resident who left before Sep 2016 remains theoretically invisible.

2018-2019.reason: Everyone bracketed. The 2018 class was EMPTY in every later source: Stein is a 2019 entrant (phase 2), the full 2022-23 roster has no PGY-5 and the effectively complete Sep-2021 list has no 2018 entrant. PubMed affiliation mining (1740 Mayo-Jax neurosurgery papers 2017-26) and a Florida NPPES screen (neurosurgery NPIs enumerated Feb-Jul 2018) found no unaccounted Mayo Jax PGY-1. A 2018 entrant who left within ~1 year cannot be fully excluded.

2019-2020.reason: Testimonial page (3 names) + bracketed reconstruction. Stein now PGY-1 (2019 entrant), not PGY-2; Ravindran PGY-1. All 2019-20 residents accounted for.

2020-2021.reason: No capture. Clifton, Gassie, Akinduro, Ravindran, Lee (2020 entrant, added) reconstructed. Ebot's exit falls here or at the end of this year (last Mayo affiliation on papers published Sep-Nov 2020; absent Sep 2021). Stein at Tennessee.

2021-2022.reason: Sep-2021 page lists every expected resident (classes 2015-2021) except the departed Ebot; treated as effectively complete (still stored as 'other' since it is a testimonial-format page without PGYs).

2023-2024.reason: No capture. Ravindran, Lee, Montaser, De Biase bracketed; Goyal (PGY-3) from Mayo-Jax neurosurgery PubMed affiliations 2023; Perez Vega (PGY-1) from NPI 2023-03 + 2024 paper footnote 'Resident ... Mayo Clinic School of GME, Jacksonville'. Complement fully accounted.

2024-2025.reason: No capture. Ravindran, Lee, Montaser, De Biase, Perez Vega bracketed; Bendfeldt (PGY-1) from NPI 2024-03 and PGY-2 in 2025-26; Goyal (PGY-4) from a paper received 2024-11 with Mayo-Jax neurosurgery affiliation. Goyal's exit from the clinical roster falls at the end of this year.
